Controlled Practice

📖 VOCABULARY · WATCH & LISTEN
🎬 Watch the video: “The worst day ever”.

Task 1: Match. Write the letter or the word. 6 pts

a. terrible   b. exhausted   c. detention   d. empathy   e. warning   f. miss the bus

  • 1 a punishment: you stay at school after lessons →
  • 2 the teacher says: “Be careful!” →
  • 3 very, very tired →
  • 4 very bad →
  • 5 you are late – the bus goes without you →
  • 6 you understand how another person feels →

Task 2: Listen. True or false? 5 pts

1 The boy misses the bus.
2 He remembers his homework.
3 He is hungry all afternoon.
4 His sister Kate says: “Tell me about your day.”
5 Mum makes him a hot chocolate.

Freer Practice

🗣 SPEAK & WRITE
🗣 Task 8: Speaking. Tell your teacher about a bad day. Use: I miss the bus · I forget my … · I get a warning · I’m exhausted · What a terrible day!
🤝 Task 9: Empathy role-play. Your friend says: “I’m sad.” · “I missed the bus.” · “I don’t want to try.” What do you say? Use: I’m here for you · That’s terrible! · Go on, give it a go! · Next time…
